releaseNotes: All mods sync from GitHub. Fixed modern timeline track and light-gray vertical volume slider.

mods.name: Classic YouTube Music player bar
mods.description: For the new miniplayer. Controls on the left, the track in the center, volume on the right — like the old bar. Keeps the new volume popup above the button.

mods.name: Modern YouTube Music player bar
mods.description: For the old player bar. Track on the left, playback controls in the center, time and actions on the right — like the new miniplayer. Volume opens above the button.

mods.name: YouTube Music: quieter chrome
mods.description: Softens a few promotional chips on music.youtube.com. Fetched from GitHub so it can change without reinstalling the extension.
